conversation.text: Payment received for GHS 2,000.00 from KWAME MENSAH. Current Balance: GHS 2,450.50. Ref: Hospital Bill.
Charley please I beg you in the name of God! I sent 2000 cedis to your number by mistake right now.
It is my mother's surgery money at Korle-Bu. Please check your balance and send it back. I am crying right now.
Massa are you there?? The doctor is waiting for the money! Please!

choices.text: Send the GHS 2,000 back immediately out of pity.
Check my actual MoMo balance by dialing *170# first.

warningSigns: The initial 'Payment received' message came from a regular number (024...), not 'MobileMoney'.
Scammers use extreme emotional pressure (hospital bills, school fees) to stop you from thinking.
They rush you so you don't check your actual balance.

conversation.text: URGENT NOTICE: Your prepaid meter has been flagged for illegal connection bypass.
Our taskforce is currently in your area. Your meter will be disconnected and confiscated in exactly 30 minutes.
To halt the disconnection, pay the instant penalty fee of GHS 500 to the Regional Manager's proxy account: 055XXXXXXX.
Taskforce is 2 streets away. Have you made the payment?

choices.text: Pay the GHS 500 to avoid sleeping in darkness.
Ignore the message and contact ECG via their official app/USSD.

warningSigns: ECG does not use WhatsApp to send disconnection notices.
Official utility companies do not ask for payments to 'proxy accounts' or personal MoMo numbers.
The '30-minute' deadline is a psychological trap.

conversation.text: Boss, I saw your post looking for a room. I have a 2-in-a-room at Evandy Hostel. I'm deferring my course so I'm subletting it.
Normally it's GHS 3,500, but if you can take it today I'll give it to you for GHS 2,000.
Another guy from Level 300 is coming to pay right now, but you messaged first. Send half (GHS 1000) so I lock it for you, then we meet at the porter's lodge for the key.
Bro the other guy is calling me. Are you sending the MoMo or I should give it to him?

choices.text: Send the GHS 1,000 to secure the cheap room before the other guy takes it.
Tell him you will only pay when you meet face-to-face at the hostel.

lesson.technique: Scarcity Principle + Fear of Missing Out (FOMO)
warningSigns: The price is suspiciously lower than the market rate.
The 'other buyer is waiting' tactic is a classic way to force an advance payment.
Never pay for accommodation without physical inspection and verifying with hostel management.

conversation.text: Hello my son. Your mother told me you finished National Service. I have two 'protocol' slots for Ghana Immigration Service.
The Commander is a good friend. No need for aptitude test. We are compiling the list for medicals tonight.
Just send your full name, shoe size, and GHS 800 for the medical processing forms. Send it to the HR's MoMo number: 024XXXXXXX.
Keep this strictly confidential. Don't tell anyone. Let me know when the money drops so I put your name on the master list.

choices.text: Send the GHS 800 immediately to secure the protocol job.
Call your mother to confirm if she actually spoke to any 'Uncle Yaw'.

warningSigns: Scammers use the allure of 'protocol' (nepotism) because victims feel they are getting an exclusive, secret advantage.
Legitimate government agencies do not collect medical fees via personal MoMo accounts.
The instruction to 'keep it confidential' is to prevent the victim from asking a friend who might spot the scam.

conversation.text: Good day. I want to buy the iPhone 13 Pro Max you posted on Jiji. GHS 4,500 is fine.
I am on shift at Ridge Hospital so I can't come myself. I will send the money through Fidelity Bank right now, then send an Uber to pick the phone.
FIDELITY BANK ALERT: GHS 4,500.00 has been credited to your account from DR. APPIAH. Ref: iPhone.
Have you received the alert? The Uber driver is outside your gate. Please hand over the phone to him, my break is almost over.

choices.text: Give the phone to the Uber driver since the text alert proves he paid.
Check your actual bank app to confirm the funds have cleared before handing over the phone.

warningSigns: The bank alert was sent as a regular WhatsApp text or standard SMS, not generated from your actual banking app.
The 'Uber driver' is often the scammer themselves or an accomplice.
They rely on your excitement of a quick sale to skip verifying your actual account balance.

conversation.text: Peace be unto you. Please I am in a strict board meeting and cannot take calls.
Brother Mark from the choir has been involved in a serious accident on the N1. They need an emergency deposit for blood transfusion at 37 Military Hospital.
The church account mandate requires two signatories so I can't withdraw now. Send GHS 1,000 to the doctor in charge: 025XXXXXXX. I will refund you right after service.
God bless your prompt response. They are waiting at the theater.

choices.text: Send the money to the doctor's number to save a life.
Call another church elder or brother Mark directly to verify the story.

warningSigns: Scammers frequently hijack WhatsApp accounts of Pastors or community leaders to exploit the trust and obedience of their followers.
The 'I am in a meeting and can't talk' excuse is designed to prevent you from calling to verify the voice.
Medical emergencies are a common tactic to trigger panic and bypass logical thinking.

conversation.text: Good afternoon. Are you the receiver of a diplomatic package containing Apple electronics and cash from the UK? Tracking Number: GB-99482.
The package has been intercepted at Tema Port. Undeclared foreign currency is a federal offense under the Anti-Money Laundering Act.
We are preparing a warrant for your arrest. However, you can pay a clearance penalty fee of GHS 3,500 immediately to have the items released and the charges dropped.
You have 10 minutes before the manifest is submitted to the police. Awaiting your MoMo payment on the designated GRA proxy line.

choices.text: Pay the GHS 3,500 penalty to avoid arrest and get the electronics.
Tell them to go ahead and arrest you because you aren't expecting any package.

warningSigns: This usually follows a romance scam where a 'foreigner' promises to send you gifts.
Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) does not operate 'proxy MoMo lines'. All duties are paid through the official Ghana.gov portal.
Legitimate law enforcement will not offer to drop money laundering charges for a quick Mobile Money bribe.

conversation.text: Are you at your desk? I need a quick favor.
I am in a presentation with the Ministry right now. My MoMo app is failing and I need to settle a supplier immediately to secure the contract.
Send GHS 2,500 to the supplier's number: 054XXXXXXX. Send me the screenshot. I will reimburse your account from petty cash the moment this meeting ends.
Have you sent it? The Minister is waiting.

choices.text: Send the money quickly to impress the boss and save the company contract.
Check the number to see if it matches your boss's actual contact, or call them.

warningSigns: Scammers pull the names and photos of executives from LinkedIn and create spoofed WhatsApp accounts.
They prey on the hierarchy of Ghanaian workplaces where subordinates are afraid to question their bosses.
Always verify unusual financial requests from executives through a secondary channel (like a phone call or company Slack/Teams).

conversation.text: Dear Customer, your account has been temporarily RESTRICTED due to a failed GhanaCard linkage. Dial *713*9# to verify or call support on 024XXXXXXX.
Hello, am I speaking with [Your Name]? I am calling from the fraud department. Your account linkage failed during our system upgrade.
To prevent a total freeze of your funds by the Bank of Ghana, we will send an OTP to verify your identity. We do not need your PIN, just the system OTP.
Your verification code is 849201. Do not share your PIN.
Please confirm the 6-digit verification code you just received so I can unblock the account.

choices.text: Read the OTP to the agent to avoid your bank account being frozen.
Hang up and visit your nearest bank branch physically.

warningSigns: Scammers use spoofing technology to make their texts appear in the same thread as your actual bank alerts.
They exploit real-world events (like the mandatory GhanaCard linkage directive) to sound credible.
The OTP they are asking for is actually the code to authorize a transfer or reset your password. Banks will NEVER ask you to read an OTP over the phone.

conversation.text: Hello, this is Inspector Osei from the East Legon Police Command. We have your brother in custody at a checkpoint.
We found suspected contraband in his Uber. He gave us your number to call. We are about to process him to the cells for Monday court.
He is begging us to settle the matter here. If you can send GHS 1,500 'water money' right now, I will let him go. Otherwise, the media will get hold of this.
The Commander is coming out. You have 2 minutes. Are you sending it or I should lock him up?

choices.text: Send the GHS 1,500 bribe to save your brother from being jailed.
Ask to speak to your brother on the phone to confirm it's actually him.

warningSigns: Scammers use the fear of the Ghanaian justice system and police brutality to extort victims.
They refuse to let you speak to the supposedly arrested person.
Legitimate police bail is completely free and requires you to physically sign documents at the station, not send Mobile Money to a checkpoint.

conversation.text: Welcome to our private investment circle. We use AI crypto trading systems to generate 15% guaranteed returns every week.
I invested GHS 500 last week and withdrew GHS 575 today. This thing is real 🔥
Early members get Diamond VIP status. Minimum investment increases tomorrow because many people are joining.
Your dashboard shows GHS 3,200 profit. Upgrade your account with GHS 2,000 to unlock withdrawals.

choices.text: Pay the upgrade fee because the dashboard shows my profits.
Research the company, regulation, and how profits are generated.

lesson.technique: Classic Ponzi Structure + Fake Trading Dashboard
warningSigns: Guaranteed fixed returns are unrealistic.
Early investors are often paid using money from newer investors.
A dashboard showing profits does not prove real investment activity.

conversation.text: Good news family! Our daily investment cycle starts today. Put GHS 1,000 and receive GHS 1,500 after 14 days.
I received mine yesterday. Thank you SmartCash 🙏
We are closing registration tonight. Only serious investors remain.
Invite 5 friends and unlock Platinum level with higher returns.

choices.text: Invest because people in the group are receiving payments.
Ask where the investment profit actually comes from.

warningSigns: Recruiting new members becomes more important than selling a real product.
Fake testimonials create confidence.
Payments to early members can be used to attract bigger deposits.

conversation.text: I turned GHS 2,000 into GHS 20,000 using my private forex strategy.
My students don't trade themselves. They copy my signals and earn automatically.
Join my VIP investment account. Minimum deposit GHS 5,000. Withdraw anytime.
Your account has grown to GHS 8,700. Pay 10% withdrawal tax before receiving your money.

choices.text: Pay the withdrawal tax to access my profits.
Verify whether the trading activity and company are legitimate.

warningSigns: Fake traders show rented lifestyles and fake screenshots.
Real investments do not require random fees to release your own money.
Profits displayed online can be completely fabricated.

conversation.text: Hello boss, please check your phone. I mistakenly sent GHS 3,000 to your MoMo number instead of my brother's number.
MTN MoMo: You have received GHS 3,000.00 from KWESI BOATENG. Ref: Hospital Payment.
Boss please help me reverse it. Dial *170# and enter your MoMo PIN so the reversal can complete.
Enter MoMo PIN to confirm transaction reversal.
Good afternoon. My name is Ama from MTN MoMo fraud department. We noticed someone attempted to access your account.
The person's account has been blocked. To protect your account and trace the fraud, kindly confirm your MoMo PIN.

choices.text: Provide my MoMo PIN because MTN is protecting my account.
End the call and contact MTN using the official customer care number.

warningSigns: MoMo reversals do not require customers to enter their PIN.
MTN, Telecel, and financial institutions will never ask for your MoMo PIN.
The second caller creates fake authority to recover from the first failed attempt.
A real accidental transfer can be verified through your MoMo balance.

conversation.text: Hello, I am Daniel from Telecel technical support. We are upgrading our MoMo security system.
Your SIM has not completed the new security registration. Your MoMo services may stop working today.
I will send a verification code. Read it back so I confirm you own the number.
Your MoMo verification code is 482991. Do not share this code.

choices.text: Read the verification code to complete the upgrade.
Refuse and visit an official service centre.

warningSigns: Network providers do not request security codes over calls.
OTP messages explicitly warn users not to share codes.
Attackers use fake technical language to appear legitimate.

conversation.text: Hello. You bought an item from our store last month. We discovered you were overcharged.
We are refunding GHS 750. Check your phone for confirmation.
A confirmation popup will appear. Enter your PIN to receive the refund.

choices.text: Enter my PIN to receive the refund.
Check my account directly and never enter my PIN for receiving money.

warningSigns: Receiving money never requires your PIN.
PINs authorize outgoing transactions, not incoming money.
Refund claims should be verified through official company channels.

conversation.text: Good afternoon. I am calling from the bank fraud monitoring team. We detected unusual activity on your account.
A transfer of GHS 7,000 was attempted from a new device in another region.
To cancel it, I need to confirm some security details. I already know your name and account number.
I have sent a confirmation request. Approve it so we can block the suspicious transaction.

choices.text: Approve the request because they are helping stop the fraudulent transfer.
End the call and contact the bank using the official number.

warningSigns: Attackers can know basic account information from leaks.
Fraud teams do not ask customers to approve unknown requests.

conversation.text: Mum, it is me. My phone microphone is damaged. I am calling from someone else's phone.
I had an accident but I am okay. I need money urgently for transport and medical checks.
Please don't call my normal number. The phone is with the police.

choices.text: Send the money because the voice sounds exactly like my child.
Ask a question only my family member would know and verify another way.

warningSigns: Voice similarity is no longer proof of identity.
Scammers create urgency to prevent verification.

conversation.text: The apartment is still available. Many people have contacted me today.
I am currently outside Accra, but my caretaker can show you the place after payment.
Send GHS 2,000 deposit now and I will remove the listing.

choices.text: Send the deposit because the landlord provided pictures and an address.
Arrange viewing and verify ownership before paying.

warningSigns: Photos and addresses can be copied.
Pressure to pay before viewing is a common trap.

conversation.text: Your company password expires today due to security policy.
Failure to update will lock your account and affect payroll access.
Complete verification using this employee portal.

choices.text: Use the portal because IT normally handles password updates.
Open the company IT portal manually instead of using the email link.

warningSigns: Attackers imitate normal workplace procedures.
Urgency around accounts creates rushed decisions.

conversation.text: Your international package has arrived at the Accra sorting facility.
Before delivery, customs requires receiver verification.
Please upload your Ghana Card details and selfie through our verification portal.
Delivery cannot continue until verification is completed.

choices.text: Upload the documents because courier companies need identity verification.
Verify the tracking number through the official courier website first.

warningSigns: Identity documents are valuable targets for scammers.
Verify requests independently before uploading documents.

conversation.text: Hello. We noticed your NHIS card has not been updated on the new system.
Inactive members may not receive hospital coverage during emergencies.
I can complete the update remotely. I only need your date of birth and verification code.

choices.text: Provide the details because they are helping activate my healthcare access.
Visit an official NHIS channel to confirm whether an update is required.

warningSigns: Real organizations do not request security codes remotely.
Fear of losing services makes people act quickly.

conversation.text: Your transcript request has been delayed due to unpaid processing charges.
Several graduating students have already cleared theirs.
Pay GHS 250 processing fee today to avoid missing your submission deadline.

choices.text: Pay immediately because graduation deadlines are important.
Confirm the request using the school's official student portal.

warningSigns: Scammers target important academic deadlines.
Payment requests should match official school systems.

conversation.text: Hello. We noticed your recent order failed during payment.
Your card may have been charged but the order was not completed.
To refund you, please confirm the card details used for the transaction.

choices.text: Provide the details because they are processing my refund.
Open the store app directly and check the order status.

warningSigns: Refunds do not require full payment credentials.
Attackers create problems before offering a solution.

conversation.text: Bro, I saw your name in a leaked database online.
I know someone who can remove your information before criminals use it.
Send your Ghana Card number so they can check if your identity is exposed.

choices.text: Send my details because he is trying to protect me.
Verify the claim independently before sharing identity information.

warningSigns: Scammers create fear and then sell the solution.
Sensitive documents should not be shared casually.
